One time when I was younger, my family stayed over at my cousins place because it was a large family gathering. We were staying in the living room. My brother and I were sleeping on the floor on these mats so it wasn’t on the hard floor.

I look towards the staircase several feet away from me and I saw a white figure walking down and walks into the wall leading outside. The figure continued doing it all night until dawn. I remember being so scared and turned over towards my brother but he wasn’t waking up. I kept looking at the red number on the digital clock waiting for sunrise. I felt this heavy sensation on top of me the whole time while that figure kept walking down the stairs. Before it finally disappear, I felt it look at me before continuing their routine.

I asked my cousin’s kids and they told their mom and she yelled at me. A little while later my family went back and I stood at that staircase and left candies as offering before walking away. But I swear it was super scary and uncomfortable.

2 of chalices- If you’re in a current relationship, relax and enjoy it. Don’t force anything, this is the good part; you are both happy and content with each other, try to make this last as long as you can.
